cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A compensation band remains identifiable independently of a worker, position, assignment, payroll result and payment.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-01.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Changing range points, currency, basis, period, geography, authority or applicability creates an immutable successor version.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-02.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A band range is neither an individual assignment nor a payable.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-03.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Minimum, reference and maximum are Money amounts and each pins currency, unit or basis, period, frequency, FTE normalization and source authority.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-04.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: An assignment may omit a band or be outside a cited range; off-band status is explicit and valid.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-05.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A Position may cite one band version for an effective interval, but that citation does not state occupant pay.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-06.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Grade, proficiency, performance and compensation band remain separate axes.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-07.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Compa-ratio, occupancy and position-in-range are observations and never band attributes.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-08.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A band change does not mutate assignment, payroll or payment history.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-09.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Original-currency values remain original; FX and frequency conversions are derived observations with source, direction, time and rounding.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-10.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Retirement preserves historical resolution and citations.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-11.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Missing range values are unknown, never zero.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-12.

cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CB-13.
